Class CodeRefinementIntent

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.java.coderefiner.CodeRefinementIntent
public class CodeRefinementIntent extends Object
A single structural, member-level modification to one Java file, applied by BatchCodeRefiner against the live PSI tree.

This is the IntelliJ counterpart of the NetBeans V4 CodeRefinementIntent. Each intent targets a class (for CodeRefinementIntent.Type.INSERT) or an existing member by canonical FQN (for CodeRefinementIntent.Type.UPDATE/CodeRefinementIntent.Type.DELETE/CodeRefinementIntent.Type.MOVE); the member source is supplied verbatim in declaration and parsed by the IntelliJ PSI element factory.

anahata
